subject.title: fix: active-memory recall fails with billing rejections on subscription-only Claude CLI setups

question: Should CliBackendPlugin.subscriptionAuthDispatch and api.runtime.agent.resolveCliBackendDispatchEligibility become the permanent plugin/runtime contract for subscription-auth embedded helper dispatch?
rationale: The observable bug and implementation are well supported, but accepting a new plugin descriptor plus runtime helper is a long-lived API and ownership choice that automated review cannot safely make.

options.title: Approve provider-owned seam
options.body: Accept the capability and shared eligibility helper, then merge after the exact-head CI failure is resolved and the branch is refreshed.

options.title: Fold into helper routing
options.body: Move this behavior into the broader canonical helper-dispatch architecture tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/57326 before landing.

options.title: Narrow the public surface
options.body: Keep the active-memory fix but replace the general plugin/runtime API with a smaller owner-approved internal seam.

recommendation.title: Approve provider-owned seam
recommendation.body: Accept the capability and shared eligibility helper, then merge after the exact-head CI failure is resolved and the branch is refreshed.
